title: Maple Banquet Hall

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: We have helped to host hundreds of meetings with local district school boards and offer many tasty snacks and beverages upon request. We love hosting your Holiday Parties here at Maple Banquet Hall and we offer customized packages to suit your business party needs. No event is too big or too small for us. We can handle it all with utmost proficiency, courtesy and respect to all. We allow outside catering and alchohol with a valid liquor license, and licensed bartenders. We supply you with wireless internet, large screens to showcase your projects and projectors available. Maple Banquet Hall is centrally located right at the NW corner of Eglington Avenue East and Dixie Road in Mississauga.

blurb: “Working with the staff at Maple Banquet Hall in Mississauga was an absolute joy from start to finish. Their attention to detail, warm hospitality, and commitment to making every moment special made our event truly unforgettable. The food was exceptional, with all meals made in-house, ensuring that every bite tasted as if it was lovingly prepared just for us.
